en_title: Palworld Developer Pocketpair Gives Employees 5 Days Off to Play GTA 6
cn_title: 《幻兽帕鲁》开发商Pocketpair给员工放假五天玩《GTA6》
opus_summary: 《幻兽帕鲁》开发商Pocketpair宣布，打算游玩《GTA6》的员工可获得五天特别假期，时间为11月19日至23日。公司表示，员工在此期间可免除日常工作，并受鼓励前往Vice City「出差」。Pocketpair负责人Takuro Mizobe也表示自己会休假游玩。

paragraphs.en: Palworld developer Pocketpair is giving its staff five days off to make their way through GTA 6 .
paragraphs.cn: 《幻兽帕鲁》开发商Pocketpair将给员工放假五天，让他们体验《GTA6》。

paragraphs.en: “All Pocketpair employees have been granted special leave to attend to an urgent five-day business trip in Vice City when GTA 6 launches,” the company said in a tweet . The company also shared a letter it presumably sent out internally to workers at the studio.
paragraphs.cn: 该公司在一条推文中表示：「《GTA6》发售时，Pocketpair的全体员工都获准享受特别假期，以便前往罪恶城进行为期五天的紧急出差。」该公司还分享了一封信，据信是发给工作室内部员工的。

paragraphs.en: “To all employees,” the letter started. “On November 19, millions of gamers around the world will find themselves sitting at school or work, gazing longingly out the window, knowing that a new era of gaming is about to begin.
paragraphs.cn: 信的开头写道：「致全体员工：11月19日，全球数百万玩家将坐在学校或工作场所，满怀渴望地凝望窗外，心知游戏的一个新时代即将开启。

paragraphs.en: “At Pocketpair, we believe that such a historic occasion deserves our full attention. Therefore, after careful consideration, we have decided that all employees who intend to play Grand Theft Auto VI will be granted a special five-day holiday.
paragraphs.cn: 「在Pocketpair，我们认为如此具有历史意义的时刻值得我们全心关注。因此，经过慎重考虑，我们决定给所有打算玩《侠盗猎车手VI》的员工放五天特别假。

paragraphs.en: The holiday period starts on GTA 6 launch date, November 19, and ends on November 23. “During this period, employees will be excused from their regular duties and are instead encouraged to take a business trip to Vice City,” the letter said.
paragraphs.cn: 假期从《GTA6》发售日11月19日开始，到11月23日结束。信中写道：「在此期间，员工无需履行日常职责，我们鼓励大家改为前往罪恶城出差。」

paragraphs.en: “We hope everyone enjoys their time away from the office and returns safely from their travels.”
paragraphs.cn: 「我们希望大家享受远离办公室的时光，并平安归来。」

paragraphs.en: All Pocketpair employees have been granted special leave to attend to an urgent five-day business trip in Vice City when GTA6 launches.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》发售时，Pocketpair的全体员工都获准享受特别假期，以便前往罪恶城进行为期五天的紧急出差。

paragraphs.en: Please see the attached notice for details. https://t.co/qJjJ7IvhhY
Pocketpair boss Takuro Mizobe tweeted to confirm he'll be making the most of the special holiday, saying: "Of course, I’ll be taking a break for a while to play GTA6 too!"
paragraphs.cn: Pocketpair负责人Takuro Mizobe发推确认，他也会充分利用这个特别假期，并表示：「当然，我也会休息一段时间玩《GTA6》！」

paragraphs.en: Pocketpair isn’t the only company talking about GTA 6’s launch. The developer behind Wardogs encouraged its players to “go play GTA 6” and come back to the game after its next big update. Hardware company Logitech also announced that it will be giving employees time off for GTA 6 . According to a new report, GTA 6 has caused a 17% spike in people requesting time off work , so it’s probably for the best.
paragraphs.cn: Pocketpair并不是唯一一家谈论《GTA6》发售的公司。《战狗》的开发商鼓励玩家「去玩《GTA6》」，等该游戏下次重大更新后再回来。硬件公司Logitech也宣布将给员工放假玩《GTA6》。根据一份新报告，《GTA6》使请假人数激增了17%，所以这样做或许是最好的。

paragraphs.en: Not long now! GTA 6 is out on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X and S. IGN's latest coverage includes speculation about a potential beloved legacy character from a previous game hiding in the latest GTA 6 trailer , and the release of new GTA 6 footage that looks so real fans actually thought it was real-life .
paragraphs.cn: 不用等太久了！《GTA6》将于11月19日登陆PS5和XBOX Series X及S。IGN的最新报道包括：有猜测称，前作中一位深受喜爱的老角色可能藏在《GTA6》的最新预告片里；此外，官方还公布了新的《GTA6》画面，其逼真程度让粉丝真的以为那是现实生活。
